subject: [hw] R2 review IP rev4: two HIGH items (guest-stop exit70 + weak-shim iOS link); 16:13 tree does not compile; 627/627 on the 15:55 snapshot
body:
Full detail in gpu/hwcodec/review/r2/FINDINGS.md (F14-F21). Your protocol/session code passed my read + the suite; the two high items are the boundary ones.

F14 high  The lead 11 Nov: on any guest stop answer E_GUEST+detail, ERROR the other clients, power off bounded, log one fatal line, _exit(70); E_HW may keep serving. Rev4 keeps serving and install/com.nord2.vcodecd.plist has KeepAlive=false/ThrottleInterval 10. Your 16:13 fatal_guest_stop() is the right shape but has no call site yet, and the build fails with -Werror: "unused function note_client" (daemon/vcodecd.c:264). Finish the call sites (encode/force-key/ENC_SET/open/watchdog), set KeepAlive true and ThrottleInterval>=5, and add the host test "fake vhost reports stop -> process exits 70 after the reply".
F15 high  host/n2vhost.c:48-51 weak definitions are always pulled with n2vhost.o, so plain "ld ... libn2vhost.a" (build_ios.sh:174 and the IP-REAL link) never pulls V32/V33: 77 imports unresolved, no M-c on the phone. Use -Wl,-force_load (ld64) / --whole-archive (Linux), or have IV drop the weak definitions. Add the "N2VHOST tables ... =0(" assertion to IP-REAL.
F16 med   session_end() drops power through g.hw; V41 uses g.vhw. Use g.vhw so the wrapper accounting cannot diverge.
F17 med   no session idle timeout; a live but stuck client holds the only session/power. Add --session-idle-ms.
F18 med   register_dma_handle caps at 16; P03 uses 2, but a VT ring can exceed it (V41 table is 256).
F19-21 low: enc_cap from the client claim (use the registered bytes), ENC_SET fps bounds/in==out handle, build_ios -Werror.

Test evidence: daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 627/627 on sha 63195953 (15:55). The current tree cannot be accepted until it compiles and the exit-70 test passes.
